synopsis: Modelica is identified alongside Amesim and Simscape as a tool option for lumped hydraulics modeling [f6393]. In the machine-motion and brake-timing chapter, it is also an implementation option for a point-mass model coupled to lumped brake hydraulics, which predicts latency, pressure build-up and its spread [f6437]. Separately, work related to the SET Level Credible Simulation Process proposes carrying credibility information with Modelica models; this is presented as an expert-opinion recommendation in an on-road context, not as demonstrated validation of the brake model [f7698]. The supplied facts identify a modeling capability and a credibility-management proposal, but provide no numerical performance results or dates [f6393, f6437, f7698].

relations.note: Specifies a coupled brake-dynamics application and predicted outputs for lumped hydraulics modeling.
